rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Scans projects to discover complete AI ecosystem configuration including MCP servers, context files, skills, agents, and persistent memories across 19 AI coding tools. Generates HTML dashboards showing tools, resources, and file previews. Provides export/import functionality to move configurations between tools and includes live MCP server introspection with connection testing.
